name: Video Game Ratings and Sales
description: Dataset derived from the dataset 'Video Game Ratings and Sales' on Zenodo. It contains around 8,000 videogames with information about their sales, developer, publisher, platform, release year, genre, ESRB rating, critic score and user score.

variableMeasured.name: rec_id
variableMeasured.description: Sales dataset record identifier for the videogame

variableMeasured.name: launch_dt
variableMeasured.description: Release date normalized to YYYY-MM-DD where available

variableMeasured.name: studio
variableMeasured.description: Developer or studio associated with the videogame

variableMeasured.name: dist
variableMeasured.description: Publisher or distributor of the videogame

variableMeasured.name: hw
variableMeasured.description: Platform or hardware on which the videogame was released

variableMeasured.name: units_sold_mm
variableMeasured.description: Total global sales in millions of units
